facts.fact: Presidential decree D/2017/184/PRG/SGG, signed at Conakry on 26 July 2017 and effective from signature, ratifies the African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection signed at Malabo on 27 June 2014, following authorising law L/2017/023/AN of 16 June 2017.
facts.system: African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection (Malabo Convention)
